response.original_title: I Love You and Today Everything Looks Beautiful
response.overview: Set between the 1950s and 1960s, the plot follows Josefina and Jorge in the aftermath of their parents' deaths. Orphaned, the children are taken in by their irreverent aunt Berta, and begin anew in the big city in a house frequented by intellectuals and where all kinds of political conspiracies are hatched.
response.title: I Love You and Today Everything Looks Beautiful
